What increased is the APPARATUS, by 71 lines in scripts/ and 222 in tests/, and GOAL-apparatus-cut's own expected_effect for this ticket accepts exactly that: "A SMALL INCREASE IS EXPECTED AND ACCEPTED -- one action or one conformance case. refinement.detail:
SEARCHED, AND THE ONE REFINEMENT ON THE RECORD WAS FOUND AND DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN. It is recorded as "found" rather than "none" because "none" would be false: CA-06's own close narrative section 6 enumerates an available model reduction -- the two now-dead ports `case_program_process` and `case_program_write`, declared under RunSpecUnitTests and @port annotated at TlaSpecDevCli.tla:506 and :509 in all three spec trees, whose effects can no longer occur since CA-06 deleted the execution mode that produced them. It needs no TLC (a port declaration is not a variable, an action or a bound) and it falls inside this ticket's declared tla conflict key.
NOT TAKEN, for three stated reasons rather than for convenience. (1) It is not this ticket's subject: the epic owner named CA-06-DF-02 at schedule_revision 2, and MF-020 as written into this ticket's work order forbids fitting work to a bug already known beyond the one assigned. (2) It is a DELETION in a CONSUMPTION ticket, and mixing them makes the regression's red/green demonstration harder for a sceptic to isolate -- the two commands in RESULTS.md section 4 touch exactly one file for exactly that reason. (3) It carries a test to update (tests/test_port_declarations.py:136 asserts one of them by name), so it is a model change with a suite consequence in a ticket whose other goal is to leave the 8-red baseline untouched.
THE REFINEMENT THAT WAS TAKEN is generator-side and is a REPLACEMENT OF A FALLBACK RATHER THAN AN ADDITION OF A CASE: negative_cases_for_corpus stops inventing argument names and reads the ones the module already declares, through the same action-marker record params_from_action_marker has read out of dumps since MF-029. One declaration, two readers, instead of one declaration and one guess. It is a byte-level no-op on every model that declares no marker -- proved on the sealed fixture in quota-ledger-corpus-unchanged.txt -- so no corpus and no TLC figure moves.
A SECOND, SMALLER SUBTRACTION IS PROPOSED AND NOT TAKEN, on CA-07-DF-04: let a line-number citation resolve BY ITS ANCHOR when the line has moved, since the checker already computes the true location and prints it. That removes a failure mode rather than adding a gate, and it is a repository-wide sweep a consumption ticket should not carry.

ticket.objective: SUBJECT NAMED AT SCHEDULE REVISION 2 BY THE EPIC OWNER, FROM WHAT THIS EPIC ACTUALLY FILED: CA-06-DF-02. THE NEGATIVE CORPUS KEYS `params` BY TLA FORMAL NAMES WHILE THE POSITIVE CORPUS KEYS THEM BY RECOVERED NAMES, SO EVERY SHIPPED ADAPTER DIES ON KeyError -- confirmed by CA-06's reviewer running all 11 recovered cases: 11 dead, KeyError 'account' x7, KeyError 'order' x4. CA-06 FILED IT AND DELIBERATELY DID NOT FIX IT, because re-keying changes corpus contents under the fixture whose sealed tables this programme quotes. IT IS THE RIGHT SUBJECT FOR THIS TICKET FOR THREE REASONS: it is a finding THIS EPIC FILED rather than a fresh defect invented for the ticket; the defect is EXACTLY an adapter-conformance mismatch, so the regression's natural home is an ADAPTER CONFORMANCE CASE, which is the owner's section 4 shape verbatim; and CA-06-DF-01 established that the measured yield of --negative-cases on a real subject is ZERO CASES EXECUTED, so this is the defect standing between a mechanism the owner chose to keep and any yield at all. THIS TICKET IS DELIBERATELY RESERVED AT PLANNING TIME AND ITS SUBJECT WAS SUPPLIED BY ITS PREDECESSORS. That is the point: the epic is testing whether consumption can be made routine, and a consumption ticket whose defect was chosen before the epic ran would be answering an easier question. AT WAVE-3 TRIAGE THE EPIC OWNER NAMES THE SUBJECT from what CA-01 through CA-06 actually filed, and records it in this entry with a schedule_revision bump. THE RULE FOR CHOOSING: use a finding THIS EPIC FILED or one already on the harvest register -- NEVER A FRESH DEFECT INVENTED FOR THE TICKET, because inventing one dodges the thing being tested. THE SHAPE, from the owner's section 4: 'a regression, once found, should be expressible as a TLA+ action or an adapter conformance case -- the most simple validated way'. Use CA-06's simplified path to do it, which is also the first real test of whether that path is usable. SV-04 is the worked precedent and its honest caveat carries: a 14-case conformance suite with durability asserted OUT OF BAND moved D3 3 -> 4 against a control, AND THE SCORE MOVEMENT IS THE OBSERVATION, NOT THE OBJECTIVE. Tuning validation to raise a number is MF-020 and fails this ticket. IF NO SUITABLE FINDING EXISTS AT TRIAGE, THIS TICKET IS RETIRED THROUGH THE CANONICAL RECEIPT FLOW WITH ITS GOAL DISPOSITION RECORDED -- and that retirement is itself a result about GOAL-consumption-obligatory, not an embarrassment to be avoided.
